lines.en: label yumigennight:
I tap on Yumi's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Yumi 的名字，等她接电话。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i} Is that really the best way to greet the guy paying for your phone bill?
lines.zh: : {i}干嘛？{/i}这就是你问候替你付手机费的人的方式？

lines.en: : I didn't ask you to pay for my fucking phone bill! You did that on your own!
lines.zh: : 我他妈又没让你替我付手机费！是你自己非要付的！

lines.en: : And I'd do it again too.
lines.zh: : 而且我还会再付。

lines.en: : Want to pay me back by hanging out with me tonight?
lines.zh: : 要不要今晚陪我，就当还我人情？

lines.en: : Ugh...do I have to? I'm all the way over at Chika's and I really don't want to fucking walk all the way back right now.
lines.zh: : 呃……非得这样吗？我在 Chika 那边，现在真他妈不想一路走回去。

lines.en: : It's fine. I'll come to you.
lines.zh: : 没事。我过去找你。

lines.en: : ...Whatever.
lines.zh: : ……随便吧。

lines.en: : Just don't fuckin' black out on the way or something.
lines.zh: : 路上别他妈的晕过去就行。

lines.en: scene black
scene yuminightgen
Yumi and I spend the night standing on top of a graveyard.
lines.zh: 我和 Yumi 晚上站在一片墓地上。

lines.en: Not the type of graveyard that houses bodies, though.
lines.zh: 不过不是埋着尸体的那种墓地。

lines.en: if bonus == True:
It's more or less just the spot where any chance for us to ever have a wholesome relationship died.
lines.zh: 这里差不多就是「我们俩建立健康关系的一切可能」死掉的地方。

lines.en: else:
It's more or less just the spot where any chance for us to ever hug again died.
lines.zh: 这里差不多就是「我们俩再次拥抱的一切可能」死掉的地方。

lines.en: And ever since then, the ground beneath us has been lined with nothing but shattered glass that we continue to cut our feet on even when we're just standing still.
lines.zh: 从那以后，我们脚下的地面就铺满了碎玻璃，即使只是站着不动，我们也不停被割伤脚。

lines.en: And so we cut our feet together.
lines.zh: 于是我们一起割着脚。

lines.en: We cut them and watch as the glow of the moon illuminates the fluid, trickling ever so slowly down a ledge that I once imagined myself pushing her over.
lines.zh: 我们割着，看着月光照亮那些液体，它顺着台沿极缓慢地往下滴——那台沿，我曾想象过把她推下去。

lines.en: Now, it's more like I'm just permanently falling instead.
lines.zh: 而现在，更像是坠落的人一直是我。

lines.en: scene black
We're only together for thirty minutes or so.
lines.zh: 我们只待了三十分钟左右。

lines.en: Any more and Yumi would probably cry.
lines.zh: 再久一点，Yumi 大概就要哭了。

lines.en: And I don't want that to happen anymore.
lines.zh: 我不想再让那种事发生了。

lines.en: if bonus == True:
Not unless she's underneath me.
lines.zh: 除非她是在我身下。

lines.zh: $ yumi_love += 1

lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度提升到了 [yumi_love]!{/i}
